label_basis: For 127.0.0.1, the vulnerable guard returns because harden is false. The fixed guard does not return when allowPrivateUrls is false; genuine node:net isIP classifies the parsed hostname as IPv4, its 127 prefix triggers a thrown source-defined policy error before fetch. The public 8.8.8.8 control does not meet the hostname/IPv4/IPv6 rejection branches.
other_changes: Additional 0/8 and mapped-IPv6 checks, a manual redirect loop and its tests/docs are retained but are not measured by the narrow initial IPv4 condition. CLI and security-configuration bytes are identical across the pair.
projection: None: all 52 regular files per snapshot, including MIT license, tests, scripts, lock and configuration, are retained. Upstream code is read only.
release_research: Original 1.1.0/1.2.1 archives and metadata are retained. Upstream history identifies this direct pair, selected before any evaluation to avoid unrelated release and startup changes.
